messages:

Subject: Clarion Health POC — scope, success metrics, and immediate next steps

Hi Tom + Emma,

Thanks again for the time today — good to meet the team. Quick recap of what we heard and the minimal POC scope we recommend so we can validate ROI within 4 weeks. Please flag anything I missed.

High-level pain points you shared:
- Clinical documentation time: clinicians spend ~18–22 minutes per chart entry; goal to shave 30–40% of that time.
- Inconsistent discharge summaries across departments, causing follow-up delays and billing friction.
- Strict PHI controls and audit requirements: no patient data should leave Clarion VPC.

Proposed POC objective (goal):
- Show a 30% reduction in average documentation time for 3 common note types (admit H&P, progress note, discharge summary) while preserving accuracy and compliance.

Scope (minimal to validate):
- Dataset: 150 de-identified example notes (you provide sanitized samples per the access checklist).
- Model: Redwood-hosted private deployment (VPC) using a curated open model variant with KV/prefix caching.
- Integration: simple web UI + API calls for clinician testing (no EHR writeback in POC).
- Duration: 4 weeks from environment availability.

Success metrics (primary / secondary):
- Primary: mean time-per-note reduction >= 30% across the 3 note types.
- Secondary: clinician satisfaction >= 4/5 in a short survey (N>=10), and <5% factuality/regression alerts on eval set.

Milestones & owners:
- Access & infra: Clarion Security to approve the VPC connection + provide sanitized sample notes (owner: Tom) — target by 9/25.
- Environment setup: Redwood infra + Neha to stand up private POC and provide endpoint + credentials — target by 9/28.
- Prompt set & evals: Aditya + Clarion SMEs to finalize 30 prompt templates and expected outputs — draft by 9/24.
- Clinician testing window: 9/29–10/09.
- Readout & next steps: 10/13 (internal readout + playbook for pilot scale).

Immediate asks (this week):
1) Tom — confirm you can deliver 150 sanitized notes and firewall IP allowlist for our VPC connector by 9/25.
2) Emma — please share the 3 clinician contacts who will join the testing window (names + emails).
3) Internal (Neha, Laura) — I'll loop you in for the onboarding call next Wed to confirm infra checklist.

Attachments: attached a one-page POC scope (clarion_poc_scope_v1.pdf) and our methods-of-proof template (redwood_mop_template.xlsx).

If that all looks good I'll schedule the environment kick-off for Mon 9/21 with Neha and your security lead.

Best,
Aditya Rao

Aditya — thanks for the clear recap. Couple quick clarifications:

1) Sanitized notes: we can export 200 notes and run our internal de-id script; I will send the first batch (150) by 9/24 EOD. The export will be CSV with note_type and created_date columns. Is that OK?

2) VPC connector: our infra team prefers TLS over an IP allowlist. Is Redwood able to accept a client-certificate-based mTLS connection instead of a static IP allowlist?

3) Clinician volunteers: I'll confirm two physicians and one RN by 9/24. They prefer short 15–20 minute sessions.

Also, curious on the evaluation: you mentioned a <5% factuality alert threshold — can you share one sample eval prompt and the rubric you'll use for factuality checks?

Tom

Tom — great, thanks. Quick answers inline and next steps.

1) Notes format: CSV with note_type and created_date is fine. We'll convert and run our ingestion sanity checks. Please include a short README describing any redaction you apply.

2) mTLS: yes, we support client-certificate mTLS for private deployments. Neha will take point on cert exchange and the exact steps; she can we schedule a 30-minute handshake with your infra on 9/23 at 10:00 AM PT?

3) Eval sample: see the short rubric below — we will run a 30-item eval across the three note types.

  - Prompt example: "Summarize the hospital course in 3 bullet points for the discharge summary."
  - Rubric (short): factual correctness (0–2), missing/additional clinically relevant items (0–2), readability (0–1). A total score <4 triggers a review. We’ll also sample-check hallucinations and medication mismatches.

Next steps I will own: schedule the infra handshake (9/23), share the prompt pack draft by EOD 9/23, and provide environment credentials when the mTLS cert is exchanged.

Neha / Laura — can you confirm availability for 9/23 10:00 AM PT?

Thanks,
Aditya
